Name: MRSSI - More Realistic Seasonal Shop Inventory
Author: JohnMarley2018
Description:
While they work on their own, these patchs are intended to be used alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26086?tab=posts&BH=1]RSSI[/url]. The changes are similar and come with the same "Standard", "Hardmode" or "Off" options (default "Standard").

Some patchs will require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]CMCT[/url] ﻿made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Spiderbuttons/about-me?gameId=1303]Spiderbuttons[/url] !

If you find issues with the balancing, let me know in the comments ! And if you like those patchs, feel free to endorse :3

Want more ? Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29229]EMRSSI[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/627831]Nrc5Skyrim[/url] !

[u][b]Config options

[/b][/u]Standard : Common randomized limited stocks with additional requirements (friendship level, skill level, in game progress,...)

Hardmode : Rarer and less abundant randomized stocks with harder additional requirements (friendship level, skill level, in game progress,...)

When using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ hover on the shop names for hints on how to unlock the content.

Detailed informations for each patch can be found in their respective spoiler tab. Keep in mind the indicated frequencies are an average !
